premises.text: Designing how to synthesize drug-like molecules is a slow, error-prone bottleneck requiring manual literature search
premises.evidence_span: Designing how to synthesize a given molecule is highly inefficient and prone to errors

premises.text: AI designs novel chemical synthesis routes from commercially available molecules within seconds
premises.evidence_span: Molecule One leverages artificial intelligence to design novel chemical synthesis within seconds instead of hours or days

premises.text: Routes are ranked by user-preferred criteria and supported with lab-tested evidence
